verdict.rationale: Runloop documents its own API with SDKs. The SDK coverage spans devbox lifecycle, file operations, command execution, blueprints, snapshots and tunnels, and there is an Agents API, so most core resources appear programmable alongside the Dashboard UI. However, no evidence states that the API matches the UI feature for feature, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404, so completeness cannot be checked. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a published OpenAPI spec or full API reference, API coverage of Dashboard monitoring/management features, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Runloop provides SDKs in common languages to interact with the Runloop API.
covering devbox lifecycle, file operations, command execution, blueprints, snapshots, tunnels, and more
The Agents API allows you to create, manage, and deploy AI agents on the Runloop platform.
